title: Verifier verdict
description: The exact one-object response of a Phase 5 verifier (fresh context, refute-first). Read by verifier prompts, the workflow graph, and validate_findings.py (enum agreement). Field semantics: verification.md.

status.description: The verdict. severity/exploitation_path apply only to confirmed/likely; a rejected verdict names the refuting code in evidence; a needs_review carries exactly one decisive missing_fact.

severity.description: From the impact anchors in SKILL.md; non-null only for confirmed/likely.

exploitation_path.description: Attacker-controlled source to sink, one step per element; only for confirmed/likely.

existing_mitigations.description: Mitigations found on the path, each with file:line.

owner_assumptions.description: User-supplied or deployment facts the verdict rests on.

evidence.description: Always present; a rejection names the code that refutes the candidate.

missing_fact.description: The one decisive fact a needs_review could not establish; null otherwise.
